decision: Rejected production change: single-pass leaf validation/indexing did not demonstrate stable performance across scales. Production remains M140.
scope: Ordinary 1000-row transactions, default cache and automatic maintenance. One database grows 600k/1M/5M/10M/20M, each scale ABBA reopens identical physical database; random/ordered min(rows,1M) reads, pagination every row.
limitations: Shared host load; ABBA is not proof that wall-time differences are caused solely by this change.
No full four-engine five-scale run; no A/B for build, update, vacuum.
Results belong to discarded experiment, not final production code.
